payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute order probabilities for two nodes based on distances from LCA using 2D DP, then sum over all pairs to get expected inversions.
payload.rationale: The solution computes a DP table on distance parameters (i,j) to determine the probability that a node at distance i from LCA is marked before one at distance j. This is a combinatorial DP, not a tree DP on subtrees. The tree is only used for LCA distances, so dp_counting_combinatorics fits best.
